title: מָה
content:
[Str3964,4101,4100] † מָה (מָא † Ezr 6:8) pron. interr. and indef. what? (BH מָה; Nab. מה; Zinj. מ; Targum מא; Syr. ܡܐ; Ar. مَاء: cf. WCG 124 f.);—1. what ? Dn 4:32 מה עבדת. 2. whatever, what (cf. BH 1 b end) Dn 2:22 ידע מח בחשׁוכא knoweth what is in darkness, Ezr 6:9: so מָה דִּי (cf. דִּי 1 b: so Nab.; Palm. מא די, מדי, Lzb306 Cooke320, 332) Dn 2:28, 2:29, 2:29, 2:45, Ezr 6:8 למא די תעבדון with regard to what ye shall do, 7:18 (= whatsoever). 3. with prefixes: a. כְּמָה how! Dn 3:33, 3:33. b. לְמָה why? (cf. BH לָמָּה) Ezr 4:22 be not slack herein: why should damage grow, etc., virtually = lest damage grow (LXX μή ποτε), 7:23 די למה להוא קצף for why should there be wrath ? = lest [LXX μή ποτε] there be wrath (cf. Targum דִּילְמָא, Syr. ܕܠܡܐ lest: and v. מָה 4 d b, p. 554:a). c. על־מה wherefore? Dn 2:15.

[Str4191,4193] † מוֺת n.[m.] death (Targum Syr.; v. BH);—abs. Ezr 7:26.

[Str4203] מָזוֺן v. זון

title: מְחָא
content:
[Str4223,4229] † [מְחָא] vb. smite (v. BH II. מָחָה);—Pe. Pf. 3 fs. מְחַת, ל rei, Dn 2:34, 2:35 (+ עַל). Pa. Impf. 3 ms. ימַחֵא בִידֵהּ 4:32, i.e. hinder him (cf. Ec 8:4 Targum; DAram. Dialektproben. p. 5; Talm.: LevyNHWB s.v.). Hithpa. Impf. 3 ms. יִתְמְחֵא Ezr 6:11 let him be smitten (nailed) עֲלָֽהִי.

[Str4255] [מַחְלְקָה] v. חלק. p. 1093

title: מְטָא
content:
[Str4291] † מְטָא, מְטָה vb. reach, attain (Targam id., Syr. ܡܛܐ, cf. Chr-Pal. SchulthLex. 108; Eth. መጠወ፡ Ar. أَنْطَي (for أَمْطَي) NöZMG xl (1886), 736; distinct from BH מָצָא, etc., q.v.);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. מְטָא Dn 4:25, ה—ָ 7:13, 7:22; 3 fs. מְטַת 4:19, מְטָת v:21 Qr (Kt, erron., מטית K§ 47, Beisp. 1) a)); 3 mpl. מְטוֺ 6:25; Impf. 3 ms. יִמְטֵא 4:8, 4:17;—1. a. reach, come to Dn 6:25 (ל loc.); come unto, as far as 7:13 (עַד Pers.); abs. arrive 7:22 (of time; LXX ἐδόθη; v. NesMM 41 who cp. Ar. عَطَي IV. give). b. reach, extend, ל loc. 4:8, 4:17, 4:19. 2. c. עַל Pers. come upon, befall 4:21, 4:25.

[Str4335–36] מֵישַׁךְ n.pr.m. (BH id.);—Dn 2:49, 3:12 + 11 t. 3.

title: מְלָא
content:
[Str4390–91] † [מְלָא] vb. fill (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 fs. מְלַאת Dn 2:35 (c. acc.). Hithpe. Pf. 3 ms. הִתְמְלִי חֱמָא 3:19 was filled with rage.

[Str4398,4406] [מַלְאַךְ] v. לאך. מִלָּה v. מלל. below, p. 1098

title: מְלַח
content:
[Str4416–17] † מְלַח n.m. salt (v. BH);—´מ: abs. Ezr 6:9, 7:22 (both for sacrifices), cstr. 4:14.

[Str4414–15] † [מְלַח] vb. denom. c. acc. cogn., eat salt;—Pe. Pf. 1 pl. מְלַחְנָא Ezr 4:14 we have eaten the salt of the palace (so most), i.e. have assumed obligations of loyalty, cf. M69* K§ 71, 2 (and Syr. ܐܬܡܠܚ be intimate with PS2134); Str (after NesMM 30 f.) thinks n. c. sf.: our salt is the salt of the palace.

title: I מלך
content:
[Str4427] I. מלך (√ of following, v. BH).

[Str4429–30] מֶ֫לֶךְ:178 n.m. king (genera1 Sem.; v. BH);—´מ: abs. Dn 2:10 + 2 t.; cstr. 4:34 + 6 t.; usu. emph. מַלְכָּא Ezr 4:8 + 154 t., ה—ָ Dn 2:11; pl. מַלְכִין Ezr 4:15 + 9 t., ים—ִ 4:13 (Hebraism, Be-Ry M41*); emph. מַלְכַיָּא Dn 2:44 + 2 t.;—king Dn 2:4, 2:5 + 132 t. Dn, Ezr 4:8, 4:11 + 42 t. Ezr (מֶלָךְ מַלְכַיָּא of Neb. Dn 2:37, of Artax. Ezr 7:12 [cf. Cooke71.3, of Xerxes]; מַלְכִין Dn 7:17 = kingdoms, cf. מַלְכוּ v:23).

[Str4433] † [מַלְכָּה] n.f. queen;—emph. מַלְכְּתָא Dn 5:10, 5:10.

[Str4437] † מַלְכוּ n.f. royalty, reign, kingdom;—abs. ´מ: Dn 2:39 +; cstr. מַלְכוּת Ezr 4:24 +; emph. תָא- Dn 2:37 +, תָה- 2:44; sf. תִי- 4:15 +, הֵתּ- 3:33 +, תָךְ- 4:23 +; pl. cstr. מַלְכְוָת 7:27; emph. וָתָא- 2:44, 7:23;—1. royalty, kingship, kingly authority: Dn 4:23, 4:28, 4:33; ´הֵיכַל מ: v:26, ´בֵּית מ: v:27, כָּרְסֵא 5:20. 2. organized (world-) kingdom: 2:39, 2:39, 2:40, 2:41, 2:42, 2:44, 7:23, 7:23, 7:24, 7:27; אֲנָשָׁא ´מ: 4:14, 4:22, 4:29, 5:21; of specif. kings 2:37, 5:18, 5:28, 6:1; of God 3:33, 7:27 (both עָלַם ´מ:), 2:44, 2:44, 3:33, 4:31, 6:27, 7:27; of Mess. 7:14, 7:14; of saints 7:18, 7:18, 7:22, 7:27. 3. realm (territorial) 4:15, 4:33 b, 5:7, 5:11, 5:16, 5:29, 6:2, 6:2, 6:4, 6:8, 6:27, Ezr 7:13, 7:23; meton. 6:5 = administration of realm. 4. reign, time of reigning Dn 5:26, 6:29, 6:29, Ezr 4:24, 6:15.

title: II מלך
content:
[Str4427] II. מלך (√ of foll.; As. malâku, counsel, advise; Targum מְלֵח, Syr. ܡܠܟ, Chr-Pal. ܡܠܟ Schulth112; BH II. [מָלַח] † Ne 5:7 as loan-word).

[Str4431] † [מְלֵךְ] n.m. counsel, advice;—sf. מִלְכִּי Dn 4:24 let my counsel be acceptable to thee.

title: מְלַל
content: [Str4449,4448] † [מְלַל] vb. Pa. speak, say (so Targum Syr.; cf. BH מלל Pi. (rare));—Pf. 3 ms. מַלֵּל Dn 6:22 he spoke with (עִם Pers.); acc. of words, Impf. 3 ms. י֫מַלִּ֔ל 7:25 (c. לְצַד of God); so Pt. act. מְמַלִּל v:8 (van d. H. here מְמַלֵּל), v:20; f. מְמַלֱּלָא (K§ 15d)) v:11.

title: מִלָּה
content: [Str4406] † מִלָּה n.f. word, thing;—abs. ´מ: Dn 2:9 +, cstr. מִלַּת v:10 +; emph. v:5 +, א—ָ, v:8 +; pl. abs. מִלּין 7:1, 7:25, cstr. מִלֵּי 5:10, emph. מִלַּיָּא 7:11, 7:16;—1. word, utterance Dn 4:28, 6:15, pl. 5:10, 7:11, 7:25; in bad sense, כִדְבָח וּשְׁחִיתָה ´מ: 2:9, מִלַּיָּא רַבְרְבָתָא 7:11 (cf. רַבְרְבָן alone v:8, v:20); word of God’s judgment 4:30; = command 2:5, 2:8, 3:22, 3:28, 6:13. 2. thing, affair, matter: 2:10, 2:10, 2:11, 2:15, 2:17, 2:23, 5:15, 5:26, 7:28, 7:28, pl. v:1, v:16.

title: מַן
content: [Str4479,4310] † מַן (so Gi, with most MSS., supported by Syr. ܡܢ, Ar. مَنْمنْ; v. K§ 22, 1), מָן (Baer: v. on Dn 3:6), interr. pron. who ? (OAram. Nab. Palm. מן Lzb312 Cooke188), Targum מן, Syr. ܡܢܡܢ, Eth. መኑ፡መኑ፡ Ar. مَنْمَنْ WCG 123: BH מִי);—1. who? Ezr 5:3, 5:9; strengthened by הוּא, Dn 3:15 וּמַן־הוּא אֱלָהּ דִּי who is the God who … ? (cf. Syr. ܡܢܘܡܢܘ contr. from ܡܢ ܗܘܡܢ ܗܘ, and מַנּוּ in the Syriacizing Targum to Pr: also BH מִי הוּא, הוּא 4 b β); so in the pl. Ezr 5:4 מִן־אִנוּן שְׁמָהָת what (lit. who: cf. מִי 1 a, and Gn 32:28, Ex 3:13 Targum) are the names of … ? 2. מַן־דּי whosoever (lit. who is there that … ? v. BH מִי g) Dn 3:6, 3:11 מִן־דִּי לָא יִפֵּל, 4:14 וּלְמִן דִּי יִצְבֵּא יִתְּנִנַּהּ to whomsoever he willeth, he giveth it, v:22, v:29, 5:21 (so Nab. מן די, Cooke241, 325 ff.; Targum מַן דְּ; Syr. ܡܢܡܢ; cf. Eg. Aram. S-CPap. K 7, 12 ולמן זי צבית תנתן).

title: מִן
content: [Str4481,4480] מִן prep. from, out of, by, by reason of, at, more than (BH and general Aram. id.);—rarely assimilated, as in Heb., v. Dn 6:5 מִצַּד, Ezr 5:11, 6:14; sf. מִנִּי, מִנָּךְ 3 m. מִנֵּהּ, f. מִנַּהּ † Dn 2:42, 7:24; 3 mpl. מִנְּהוֺן (so Palm.:Tariff ii. a 34; Nab. Eg. Aram. מנהם, CookeNo. 89. 6, S-CPap. A 10) † Dn 2:33, 2:33, 2:41, 2:41, 2:42, 2:42 Kt (Qr each time f. מִנְּהֵן), 6:3, 6:3;—1. of place: a. from, Dn 4:10, 4:11, 4:28, 7:4 +, מִן תַּמָּה † Ezr 6:6; fig. on the side or part of (cf. BH 1 c) Dn 6:5 מִצַּד מַלְכוּתָא. b. out of, Dn 3:15, 3:26, 5:2, 7:3, etc. c. (coming) from 2:35, away from, 2:45, 4:11, 4:22, 4:28, Je 10:11. d. to ask or exact of a person, Dn 2:16, 2:49 +; Ezr 7:26; to deliver from Dn 6:21. 2. a. of the source (BH 2 b), as to be fed from Dn 4:9; or author (ib. d), מִנִּי שִים טְעֵם = by me is a decree made, Dn 3:29, 4:3 (6:27 מִן־קֳדָמַי), Ezr 4:19 +, cf. 5:17; מִנַּי = on my part Dn 2:5, 2:8 (v. אַזְדָּא). b. of the immediate cause, as a result of, by, Dn 4:22 (= ב v:12, v:20), v:30, 5:21: so with a vb. of fearing 5:19. c. of the remoter cause, by reason of (BH 2 f ), Dn 5:19 מִן־רְבוּתָא, 7:11; so מִן־דִּי, v. דִּי 3. d. of the norm (cf. BH 2 g) = at, according to, Ezr 6:14 ´מִן־טַעַם אֱלָהּ יִש: at the decree of, etc., 7:23, Dn 2:8 מִן־יַצִּיב according to certainty, v:47 מִן־קְשֹׁט. 3. partitively (BH 3), Dn 6:3 חַד מִנְּהוֺן, 7:8, 7:16, 2:25, 5:13; (some) of 2:41 מִן־נִצְבְּתָא; מִנְּהוֺן…מִנְּהוֺן: some … others of them 2:33, 2:41, 2:42 a, so v:42 b מִנַּהּ…:. 4. of time, from, Dn 2:20 (וְעַד…מִן:), Ezr 4:15, 4:19; v. also אְדַיִן and דַּי 4. 5. in comparisons, different from Dn 7:3, 7:7, 7:19, 7:23, 7:24, beyond, more than 2:30, 2:39, 6:30, 7:20 end; 4:13 לִבְבֵהּ מִן־אֲנָשָׁא יְשַׁנּוֺן let his heart be changed away from man’s (BH 7 b b; Is 52:14). 6. cpds.:—v. לְוָת, קֳדָס, [קַדְמָה], תְּחוֺת.

content:

title: מְנָה
content:

content:

[Str4510] מִנְיָן v. מנה. above

[Str4606] מֵעָל v. עלל
